command: set -e; cd /code; n=0; until python3 manage.py migrate --noinput; do n=$((n+1)); if [ $n -ge 30 ]; then echo 'osf_init: migrate failed 30 times' >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "osf_init: database not ready yet, retry $n"; sleep 10; done; n=0; until invoke search_ensure_index; do n=$((n+1)); if [ $n -ge 30 ]; then echo 'osf_init: search_ensure_index failed 30 times; is elasticsearch8 up and elasticsearch8_setup done?' >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "osf_init: search not ready yet, retry $n of 30"; sleep 10; done; n=0; until python3 -m scripts.populate_institutions -e test -a; do n=$((n+1)); if [ $n -ge 30 ]; then echo 'osf_init: populate_institutions failed 30 times' >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "osf_init: populate_institutions failed, retry $n of 30"; sleep 10; done; python3 -m scripts.register_oauth_scopes; echo 'osf_init: done'
note: One-shot database initialisation (real install run 12: a fresh postgres has no tables, so web answered 500 with `relation osf_institution does not exist`). Runs, in the osf.io image as uid 1000, the steps the upstream README lists for a new install: `manage.py migrate`, `scripts.populate_institutions -e test -a` (the institutions the acceptance tests and the institution admin screens need; it also writes them to Elasticsearch 8, which is why `invoke search_ensure_index` runs first: it creates the index website_v1 with the Japanese-analyzer mapping and the alias website when they are missing, because a write to a missing index would create it with a dynamic mapping that breaks aggregations (RDM-osf.io-dev2027 PR #11); both steps retry for up to 5 minutes while elasticsearch8_setup finishes) and `scripts.register_oauth_scopes`. All three are idempotent, so the service runs at every `up` and exits 0 quickly when nothing changed; web, api, admin and worker wait for it with condition service_completed_successfully. A Django `migrate` against a half-started postgres is retried every 10 s for up to 5 minutes. tmpfs /code/logs: scripts/utils.py add_file_logger writes a per-run log file there (real install run 13: register_oauth_scopes failed on the read-only root). With RDM-osf.io-dev2027 PR #10 (admin two-factor sign-in) the `migrate` also applies addons_twofactor 0006 and 0007 (the admin project runs no migrations itself).
